_comment: The product contract. Entities and journeys the build is measured against by scripts/check-contract-coverage.mjs. Start with this much: entity ids, field names, and a hand-maintained journey state. It is worth doing at Tier 2 and up.

entities.description: A bill sent to a customer. Immutable once issued.
entities.notes: pdf_url is populated asynchronously after issue. Absent on a draft.

entities.description: The billed party. One per Stripe customer.
An active plan. Seat changes take effect immediately, bill at period end.
A settled charge against an invoice.

journeys.gap: no email preview, no resend. BR-014 requires both.
entirely unbuilt. No UI, no route.

rules.text: An invoice can be resent to the same address any number of times, but changing the recipient requires voiding and reissuing, because the original is the legal record.
rules.source: Client call 2026-08-12. Finance lead: 'the address on the sent one has to be the address it went to.'

rules.text: Seat additions take effect immediately and bill at the next period boundary. Plan upgrades prorate immediately.
rules.source: DECISIONS.md 2026-08-30. Consolidates former BR-007 and BR-018.
rules.note: Whether a seat REMOVAL credits at period end is an inference, not agreed. See OQ-009.
